name: Horrible Shrimp 47
author: Voxybuns
description: White toggle switch that toggles on and off when clicked.
howItWorks: On hover, transform becomes translateY(-0.3em), box-shadow becomes 0 0.3em 0 #000, transform becomes translateX(calc(2em - 1em)) translateY(-0.3em). Clicking it toggles it: background-color changes from #e8e8e8 to #888, transform becomes translateX(calc(2em - 1em)) translateY(-0.2em), transform becomes translateX(calc(2em - 1em)) translateY(-0.3em). On focus, box-shadow becomes 0 0 0 2px #888.
